# [Block Garden Knowledge Hub](https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden-knowledge-hub/)

> Interactive documentation for Block Garden, a 3D voxel sandbox for exploration, building, and farming built with vanilla Web technologies. Published with ShadowClaw.

## Docs

- [README](https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden-knowledge-hub/README.md): Overview and local development
- [AGENTS.md](https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden-knowledge-hub/AGENTS.md): Conventions for AI agents working on this hub
